why: Instrument defect found while building, before any measured run: the test built its excluded URL by prefixing https://github.com/ to the corpus protocol's first excluded_repos pattern, but the patterns already hold the host and name an organization (github.com/<org>/), so the URL became https://github.com/github.com/<org>, which no pattern matches, and the test could hold under no implementation of the clone rule. The URL is now https://<pattern><repo> (a repository of the excluded organization). The rule checked (an excluded URL is refused and never cloned) is unchanged; nothing is cloned or read.

Found on merging the lead's M6 tools landing (55c679df), after the measured runs, which R1 does not read. The test stripped only generator_sha256 before comparing M0-M3 outputs with its base c2cd112c, on the premise that the lead's re-stamp moves only that field. The landing's re-stamp also refreshed every record's `seconds` fields and results/<m>/metrics_timing.json, which G1 never compares (holon.gate norm_records strips every `seconds`; G1_EXCLUDED holds metrics_timing.json). This is the defect the lead amended in I103-R1 and I104-B10 (spec/M6/amendments/I103.jsonl, I104.jsonl); the amended check is theirs: it also strips `seconds` and skips G1_EXCLUDED's files. Every other field, status and file is still compared, and the claim (M0-M3 move only by re-stamp) is unchanged.

Ruling change (HUMAN_ANSWERS Q64, Q67; delegated by the lead on #179): Q64 made machines.nil_maps "unknown" the Go machine frontend's default (I109 (g)); this test relied on the old default, under which a config without the key carried no nil_map debt. Q67: a test is never left out of its CI job, so it is amended to name the mode it was written for, the explicit opt-out "zero", in a temp copy of its config (the fixture files are not edited). Every assertion is unchanged. The plain arm extracts with a temp copy of go_config.json plus machines.nil_maps "zero", so P2 (SYM per model, independent of nil maps) and P3 (debt under "unknown", never under "zero") read as written.
